headline: St. Lucie County Firefighter-Paramedic Austin Hodge Dies in Line of Duty
teaser: Firefighter-Paramedic Austin Hodge died on duty Oct. 24, the St. Lucie County Fire District announced, about 15 months after the death of his younger brother, Jarius, also a firefighter.
body:
ST. LUCIE COUNTY — Firefighter-Paramedic Austin Hodge died Saturday, Oct. 24, while on duty, the St. Lucie County Fire District announced.

Hodge joined the district on July 17, 2017, and served the community for more than nine years. He was assigned to Station 9.

His death comes 15 months after the death of his younger brother, Jarius Hodge, who also served as a firefighter-paramedic with the district. Jarius died in July 2025 after becoming ill while on duty. In interviews with WPTV and WPBF following Jarius’s death, Austin spoke about their close bond and their shared commitment to the fire service.

The district described Austin Hodge’s death as a profound loss to the department and the wider fire service community. It extended condolences to his family, friends and fellow firefighters. The district did not disclose the circumstances of his death in its October 24 announcement.

The district asked that the family’s privacy be respected as they grieve. Information about memorial arrangements and opportunities to honor Hodge’s service will be shared in coordination with his family once details are finalized.
